claims.statement: For every fixed disjoint activation pair a,b with a+b and a-b Boolean, the exact biased coherent remainder R_mu(alpha) at a physical query is the Doob decrement of J_{a,b}(g)=Eraw(a+gb)-||b||_2^2 Eraw(g), and therefore its weighted sum telescopes on every complete adaptive restriction tree.

For the one-bit selector interface with arbitrary Boolean indicator s of mean p, the complete hierarchy sum equals Q(p)=psi(p)+psi(1-p)-psi(2p-1)/2+4p(1-p)ln2 and is at most 8p ln2, hence at most 32 ln2 times the influence of d=((1-x)/2)s.

After the fixed-pair Doob terms are telescoped, a hierarchy with changing activation pairs has only inter-node potential mismatches J_{a_v,b_v}(h_child)-J_{a_child,b_child}(h_child) left to control; this statement is a reduction, not a bound for those mismatches.
